ItemID: unavailable; Title: Muddy Waters & The Rolling Stones Live At The Checkerboard Lounge, Chicago 1981 DVD/CD; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The live blues collaboration interests me, but I would choose a studio album this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Powerful People; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not recognize enough about this release to choose it during a brief visit.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My recent interest in Old Sock makes this relaxed blues tribute my strongest pick today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: New; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not give me a strong enough connection to what I want now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Blue & Lonesome; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues direction appeals to me, but I am only choosing one album today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Way Down in the Jungle Room; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in blues guitar and roots songwriting right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Endless River; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Atmospheric instrumental rock is less appealing than the blues-oriented listening I want today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Django and Jimmie; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Blown Away suggests some country interest, but I am not seeking a traditional country duet album now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Blues; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The title suggests a fit, but without an artist I would pass over it for a clearer choice.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Best Of Dire Straits and Mark Knopfler: Private Investigations; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The guitar playing and songwriting appeal to me, but a compilation is less tempting than the JJ Cale tribute today.
